dedupe_resolutions.notes: Vance's end-times statement was made in a broad faith interview and did not explicitly concern Iran or any particular official act. It remains a distinct governance and risk-framing statement rather than being merged into the Iran/Hormuz war record.

The shared EO 14420 token is intentionally preserved in the grid record's timestamped correction note and source description. The official Federal Register assigns EO 14421 to the August 26 grid order and EO 14420 to the August 10 vaccine order; the records concern distinct events and subjects.

The shared White House fact sheet reports both manufacturer pricing arrangements and Medicare Bridge uptake. One record concerns announced company agreements; the other concerns an administration-reported program measurement.

The August employment release is an independently measured economic outcome. Trump's subsequent trade threat used the report as context but is a distinct presidential risk statement with no implementing instrument; neither record substitutes for the other.

The September 4 orders direct ranching, competition, processing, wolf and labeling actions. The August 26 proclamation separately implemented a temporary lean-beef import quota increase; the instruments and outcome tests are distinct.

The national measles surveillance outcome concerns a vaccine-preventable infectious disease. The August 31 newborn record measures vitamin K nonreceipt, which is not a vaccine and involves a different intervention, population and outcome.

LEG-004706 records the June 22 district-court summary judgment vacating modified SAVE. The new record covers the September 4 appellate refusal to stay that judgment and the expedited merits appeal; both stages remain cross-referenced under the same litigation.

The Central African Republic record covers a second implemented flight to that country. The Guyana record covers the first implemented group under a separate bilateral arrangement, different people and different post-transfer terms.

The Liberia record documents a separate agreement and capacity announcement. The Guyana record documents actual arrival of a different six-person group under a one-year temporary arrangement; neither is a duplicate of the other.

rejected_candidates.title: Twenty-four new Trump Truth Social posts
rejected_candidates.reason: The posts comprised Labor Day and midterm rhetoric, repeated SAVE America Act advocacy, a link to an Iran opinion report, a February ETF-tax claim, routine monument and fountain maintenance, and 15 image-only posts. They remain in the separate raw-post feed because none independently established a new material federal action, ruling, expenditure or measured policy result.

rejected_candidates.title: Repeated threat to sue the Center for American Progress and its supporters
rejected_candidates.reason: Trump republished a threat whose substance and proposed contributor defendants had already been reported in August. No complaint, docket, demand or other new legal lifecycle event was located by cutoff, so the post is retained as presidential publication evidence rather than promoted as a new action.

rejected_candidates.title: Labor Day fuel-price follow-up
rejected_candidates.reason: Associated Press repeated the $4.14 regular-gas average, record diesel prices, 98% refinery utilization and overlapping war, refinery and global-supply causes already captured in the Iran/Hormuz record. The later story supplied corroboration but no materially different measurement, government action or policy outcome.

rejected_candidates.title: Record U.S. imports of Congolese copper
rejected_candidates.reason: Reuters measured a July import shift associated with increased Congolese output, improved quality, discounts and shipments ahead of a possible tariff. Because no tariff was implemented and the multi-cause market result does not yet test a completed administration action, it remains a research lead rather than a padded national record.

rejected_candidates.title: Mail-ballot and Ukraine diplomacy follow-ups
rejected_candidates.reason: New reporting produced no Supreme Court order, ceasefire, agreement or other lifecycle change beyond the pending filing and completed meetings already captured in existing records.

rejected_candidates.title: September 8 Federal Register public-inspection queue
rejected_candidates.reason: Potentially material FCC direct-to-device and Interior Alaska production-site proposals were filed before this review window and carry September 8 publication dates after the cutoff. They were not backdated into this release and remain candidates for the next evidence window.

rejected_candidates.title: Legacy duplicate-candidate batch
rejected_candidates.reason: The three surfaced same-date heading pairs were inspected and concern different courts, parties, authorities and events. No responsible merge, correction or guarded historical revision was warranted; the disclosed queue remains visible.

rejected_candidates.title: External archive discovery leads
rejected_candidates.reason: All four registered archives were rechecked at their primary project pages or official public endpoints. Their independently labeled measurements remained unchanged or could not be freshly verified, and no upstream item advanced without original-source inspection and full Record review.
